# 1,000.00 USD bought into A at −500.00 with 7,800.00 HKD, in a transaction
# stated in Canadian dollars, giving A's owed cost basis.
#
# The split into A crosses zero: it repays the 500.00 owed, at the 1.35 that
# cost, 675.00, and brings 500.00 in. With a second foreign currency in the
# transaction, its Canadian dollar figures say what the Hong Kong dollars were
# worth, not what the US dollars came at, so the value on the split is the
# file's statement of it: 1,375.00, which costs the 500.00 brought in at 1.40.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 commodity HKD
	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-02-01 open Assets:HKD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"

2034-02-01 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD into A with Hong Kong dollars"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:HKD Bank -7800.00 HKD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
		share_price: "55/312"
		value: "-1375.00"
	Assets:USD A 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "11/8"
		value: "1375.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000001"
